name: Graft Armor
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level: gifted blade 3, psychic warrior 3

CASTING

Display: olfactory
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 24 hours (D)
Power Points: 5

DESCRIPTION

Any armor you are wearing becomes a natural extension of your body, and blends seamlessly with your form. Now that the armor and you are one, your Maximum Dexterity Bonus increases by 1, the armor’s Armor Check Penalty is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0), any arcane spell failure is reduced by 10%, and the armor is treated as one step lighter for all purposes except armor proficiency (light armor is still considered light armor).

When this power’s duration expires, the armor detaches normally and remains equipped.
